title: Deliver Livestock to Radworth Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Livestock** delivered to **Radworth Factory** (industry id 29, near tile 178,132).

A likely supplier is **Radworth Farm** (industry id 10, near tile 194,139); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **270 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
